descriptor: Randomization-Marginal Measurement Sufficiency, Sequential Stopping Boundaries, Representation-Specific Sample Complexity, Decision-Stable Estimation & Hosted-Inference Measurement Budget Constitution

predecessor.key_result: Gemini explicit-seed randomization produced a highly reproducible 16-vs-16 marginal surface and strong Monte-Carlo convergence; Groq-hosted GPT-OSS showed convergence and single-draw bias but failed independent-half surface reproducibility at the P50 budget.

theoretical_reframing.problem: P50 establishes that a marginal estimand can exist even when realization-level seed geometry fails. P51 asks when that estimand has been measured enough for a declared resolution and whether the required budget is itself representation-dependent and reproducible.
theoretical_reframing.new_object: For model/interface m, representation vertex v, and declared full-width resolution w, define tau_m(v,w) as the first draw count at which an anytime-valid confidence sequence for pi_m(v) has width <= w. The map v -> tau_m(v,w) is the representation-specific measurement-sufficiency field.
theoretical_reframing.central_question: Is measurement sufficiency a reproducible field over representation space rather than a single global attempt count, and can that field support stable representation-effect decisions under optional stopping?

authority_order.gemini: Primary constitutive interface because P50 established its randomization-marginal estimand.
authority_order.gptoss120_groq: Boundary/rescue interface. P51 may test whether a larger 32-vs-32 budget constitutes a stable marginal surface, but cannot assume one in advance.

gemini.randomization_semantics: 64 fresh nominal explicit seeds; seed numbers are labels, not a metric.

gptoss120.randomization_semantics: 64 repeated hosted draws under the exact frozen contract; draw index is not treated as an explicit RNG coordinate.

surface.primary_vertex_outcome: J(v,r)=1 iff both valid and null twins are adjudicated correct in randomization draw r.

sequential_inference.confidence_sequence: Bernoulli Beta(1,1) mixture e-process inversion. For each vertex and each block, C_t(v)={p: mixture_likelihood/null_likelihood < 1/alpha}. This is time-uniform under the Bernoulli conditional-mean model.
sequential_inference.simultaneous_alpha: 0.05/32 per vertex for a conservative 32-vertex simultaneous layer.
sequential_inference.stopping_time: tau(v,w)=first t<=32 with individual-CS full width <=w; tau=33 if unresolved by the block cap.
sequential_inference.global_layer: Separately report whether every vertex's simultaneous CS reaches each resolution by t=32; this is not required for the representation-specific field to exist.

block_surface_reproducibility.tests: Gemini and GPT-OSS separately: Pearson correlation of 32-draw marginal surfaces pi_A(v) versus pi_B(v).

stopping_field_reproducibility.tests: For each model and each w in {0.50,0.40,0.30}, Pearson correlation of censored stopping-time vectors tau_A(v,w) versus tau_B(v,w).
stopping_field_reproducibility.meaning: Tests whether the relative measurement difficulty of representations is itself reproducible.

primary_tests.multiplicity: Eight primary tests total: 2 surface + 6 stopping-field tests, one Holm FWER=0.05 family.

decision_stability.representation_operator_graph: The 5-dimensional Boolean cube has 80 single-factor edges. For each factor, average the 16 paired on-minus-off marginal effects.
decision_stability.certification: Use the conservative simultaneous per-vertex confidence sequences to derive an interval for each factor-average effect at each t. A sign is certified only when the derived interval excludes zero.
decision_stability.stable_decision: A factor effect is decision-stable only if both independent blocks certify the same sign. No equivalence margin is introduced in P51.

budget_outputs.counterfactual_vertex_retirement: For each block/model/resolution, sum min(tau(v,w),32) over vertices and multiply by two semantic calls. Compare with the fixed 32-draw budget.
budget_outputs.sample_complexity_field: Report tau(v,w) for all 32 vertices, plus factor/vertex summaries.
budget_outputs.censoring: Unresolved tau=33 is reported as right-censored; it is never imputed as a successful stop.

verdict_gates.technical: All 8192 scientific calls must be exact-schema successful; otherwise TECHNICAL_HOLD and only failed calls may be replayed.
verdict_gates.artifact: Primary-vs-shadow disagreement >=10% in either interface triggers EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT.
verdict_gates.surface: An interface has a reproducible marginal surface only if its surface test is positive and Holm-rejected.
verdict_gates.full_sufficiency_field: An interface must have a reproducible marginal surface and positive Holm-rejected stopping-field correlations at all three resolutions.
verdict_gates.coarse_sufficiency: Surface gate plus only w=0.50 stopping-field test survives Holm.

already_known: Sequential testing and adaptive stopping for model evaluation already exist.
Confidence sequences / optional-stopping-safe inference are classical statistical machinery.
Stochastic LLM evaluation and resampling-count estimation already exist.
Repeated attempts under hosted nondeterminism are already known to have claim-dependent budgets.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: A representation-conditioned, resolution-indexed stopping-time field over a declared intervention cube, together with independent-block reproducibility of that field and a decision-stability layer for representation-operator effects after randomization marginalization.

canonical_drive: Atıl et al. (2025), hosted LLM nondeterminism.
acquisition_queue: Arviv et al. (2026), Stop Guessing When to Stop Testing: Efficient Model Evaluation with Just Enough Data, Findings ACL 2026.
Certified Sequential Inference for Repeated-Sampling LLM Evaluation (2026 preprint/site; verify archival publication before using as authority).
Wu & Kawai (2025), Stopping Rules for Monte Carlo Methods: A Review.

independence_from_other_labs.rule: MQR/NOMOS/P&K may donate falsifiers or formal cautions, but P51's explanandum remains the measurement budget of hosted LLM response observables. No general philosophy-of-science, institutional-authority, or person-judgment claim is imported.

frozen_rules: No width target is selected after outcomes; the full resolution ladder is retained.
No numeric geometry is assigned to Gemini seed labels or Groq draw labels.
The individual-CS stopping field and the simultaneous global layer have different authority and must not be conflated.
Generic sequential-testing novelty is explicitly disclaimed.
A stable stopping field does not identify provider internals or neural states.
No threshold, alpha allocation, null model, or multiplicity rule changes after outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P51 alone.
